Make mealtime magical with our gorgeous doll-sized Bear HighChair!  A charming highchair for playtime fun, perfect for dolls up to 40 cm tall with the cushion, and up to 45 cm tall without the padded cushion.
This heirloom piece brings elegance to playtime. Especially designed for little hands. A timeless addition to any playroom.
Each handcrafted highchair comes with a natural cotton chair pad with side ties 
Dimensions:  25cm L x 55cm H x 25cm D   
As Seen on the Late Late Toy Show 2022
Please note: The measurements we provide are a guide, they may vary slightly as every piece is uniquely crafted by hand. Small variations of shape and colour may also vary from the images shown as our products are made from natural materials.
